statement: Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions. Classifies singular and absolutely continuous unbiased Bernoulli convolutions for every $`\lambda\in(0,1)`$ by an infinite, one-sided approximation condition using explicit finite sets of algebraic units. It also proves singularity at reciprocals of every quartic Salem number in $`(1,2)`$, giving examples beyond reciprocal Pisot parameters.
